policy: No patient-facility boundary may transition to enforced until an isolated environment proves both same-facility allow and cross-facility deny behavior for reads and mutations.

fixture_requirements.user_a: non-admin user with active membership only in facility A
fixture_requirements.user_b: non-admin user with active membership only in facility B
fixture_requirements.patient_a: patient explicitly linked to facility A
fixture_requirements.patient_b: patient explicitly linked to facility B

transition_requirements.reviewed: all required cases have recorded observations matching expected outcomes
transition_requirements.enforced: reviewed plus isolated database identity/fixture evidence and no production fixtures
